entities.summary: Markus Zoecke is a German former professional tennis player. Zoecke's primary weapon was a powerful serve that he could hit thanks to his height. He reached a highest singles ranking of No. 48 in March 1992. During his career he won one singles and one doubles title. He played three matches for the German Davis Cup team in 1992 and 1995.
